text: The 'Madeira. Tão tua' destination brand is published by the Associação de Promoção da Madeira (Madeira Promotion Bureau), the association that promotes the Madeira destination; the brand is used by VisitMadeira and by the Regional Government of Madeira.
short: 'Madeira. Tão tua' is the Madeira Promotion Bureau's destination brand, also used by the Regional Government of Madeira.

source.note: Official site of the 'Madeira. Tão tua' destination brand (landing page titled 'Bem-Vindo à Marca Madeira' presenting the brand and its signature); the footer credits the Associação de Promoção da Madeira. Undated.

additionalSources.name: TNews: Afinal o que reflete a nova marca da Madeira?
additionalSources.quote: Esta é a nova imagem da Madeira que será usada não só para a promoção do destino pelo VisitMadeira, como pelo próprio Governo Regional
additionalSources.note: Report on the brand's 12 April 2021 presentation: the 'Madeira / Tão tua' image is used by VisitMadeira (the Madeira Promotion Bureau's destination brand) and by the Regional Government itself; the Promotion Bureau's executive director Nuno Vale spoke at the launch.
